latest_release.name: Backbone Fundamentals 1.2.0
latest_release.body:
This is a minor release of Backbone Fundamentals, but comes with a relatively large backlog of changes. These have been available live on the book site for some time, but are finally getting tagged to get back onto a more regular release cycle.

Changelog: https://github.com/addyosmani/backbone-fundamentals/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0

Changes are up on the site already: http://addyosmani.github.io/backbone-fundamentals/

We've also bumped checked in versions of ePub, Markdown & Mobi versions of the book. We'll try to get out a revised PDF version shortly.
